quote.summary: Zhongji Innolight Co Ltd is a China-based company principally engaged in the research and development, design, manufacturing, and sales of high-speed optical transceivers. The Company operates its businesses through two segments. The Optical Transceivers segment mainly offers a portfolio of optical modules ranging from 100G to 1.6T. The Others segment offers optical components used in optical communication networks. The product portfolio covers components in optical transceivers and related optical communication equipment, including Transistor Outline Can (TO-CAN) packaged components, which are small electronic or optical components sealed in metal can packages for reliable operation and connectivity with other equipment, optical sub-assembly (OSA) and other optical communication devices. The Company mainly conducts its businesses in the domestic and overseas markets.
